title: Fastidious: for designers who are never satisfied
purpose: Designers can now produce a plausible website in minutes, and most of what gets made looks the same. This film shows designers how Fastidious gets them to a result they would put their name to: it starts with why, gives the work a personality worth keeping, sweats the small things, and shows the work as well as it was made.
audience: A designer or design lead who already uses AI tools, is quietly unhappy with how generic the output is, and wants a process that raises the bar rather than lowering the effort. After watching, they install Fastidious and run it on a real brief.
single_idea: The best designers are always dissatisfied. Fastidious is built for them.
sign: exacting care; a hand that knows when something is a hair off; quiet confidence rather than spectacle

tokens.light: a single soft key from high camera left, deep falloff into ink-blue shadow, no fill, no rim light
tokens.lens: 50mm to 100mm macro equivalent, shallow but believable depth, locked or slow dolly, no handheld shake
tokens.texture: real materials: uncoated paper, enamel, brass, wax, planed wood; fine grain like 35mm print film, never glossy CGI
tokens.composition: one subject, generous negative space, horizon and edges deliberately placed, asymmetric
tokens.mood: the quiet of a studio after hours; patient, precise, unhurried

avoid: racing cars, helmets or chequered flags

music._note: A restrained piano or string pulse around 80 to 90 BPM suits the mood; choose and license it before generating.
